implementation.summary: Execution and delivery are separate. Logical-subagent successes are persisted through the existing ZetsuResultStore, large results receive a bounded reference envelope, and completed outcomes use an explicit bounded cache.
implementation.persistent_protocol: Existing ZetsuResultStore result_id plus owner/repo/session-bound base64 byte paging; no second paging protocol.

previous_phase_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_corrective_c1_results.py tests/test_logical_subagents_g11.py tests/test_bounded_aci_g6.py tests/test_memory_g2.py tests/test_repository_context_g4.py tests/test_hooks_g9.py tests/test_laplace_core_g1.py tests/test_zetsu_hotfix_lifecycle.py tests/test_release_v7.py

notes: Result retrieval delegates to the existing owner/repository/session authorization checks.
Artifact names and result IDs remain strictly validated by ZetsuResultStore.
No model-supplied filesystem path is accepted for logical result retrieval.
Cache eviction removes only in-memory outcome metadata; it never deletes durable result artifacts.

remaining_scope: Scheduling, GPU admission, and batch deadline defects remain C2 scope.
Bounded ACI continuation remains C3 scope.
